gloss: adult entertainment establishment; sex industry business

definitions.gloss: adult entertainment establishment; business in the sex or hostess industry
definitions.explanation: A business that falls under Japan's entertainment licensing regulations ({風俗営業法|ふうぞくえいぎょうほう}), ranging from hostess bars and cabaret clubs to more explicit adult services. Commonly appears in news coverage of entertainment districts and law enforcement.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{地区|ちく}→地区：03463_chiku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{風俗店|ふうぞくてん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}く→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦{集|あつ}まっている→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧。
examples.english: Many adult entertainment establishments are concentrated in that district.

examples.japanese: ⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{無認可|むにんか}→無認可：29032_muninka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{風俗店|ふうぞくてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{摘発|てきはつ}→摘発：12935_tekihatsu⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Police cracked down on unlicensed adult entertainment establishments.

examples.japanese: {風俗店|ふうぞくてん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧⟦{女性|じょせい}→女性：01617_josei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、さまざまな⟦{背景|はいけい}→背景：28348_haikei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Women who choose to work at adult entertainment establishments have various backgrounds.

notes:
Combines ⟦{風俗|ふうぞく}→風俗：14694_fuuzoku⟧ (customs; here: adult entertainment) and ⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧ (shop, establishment). In everyday Japanese, ⟦{風俗|ふうぞく}→風俗：14694_fuuzoku⟧ often implicitly refers to the sex/entertainment industry when used without further context.

RELATED WORDS:
- {風俗業|ふうぞくぎょう}: the adult entertainment business/industry
- {風俗嬢|ふうぞくじょう}: a woman working in adult entertainment
- {性風俗|せいふうぞく}: sexual customs; the sex industry (more explicit term)
